context: A barista and her friend chat about clothes and everyday habits
purpose: Teach: たしかに/やたら/繰り返す/たいてい/いっしょ/せめて/格好/元々

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: ねえ、最近やたら寒くない？お店来るお客さん、たいてい厚着してるよ。
lines.en: Hey, isn't it weirdly cold lately? Most customers coming to the shop are bundled up.
lines.style: Casual barista chatter, warm and observational tone.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: わかる〜。私も元々寒がりだから、せめてマフラーくらい巻きたいなって思ってて。
lines.en: I get it. I've always been sensitive to cold, so I at least want to wrap a scarf.
lines.style: Soft dreamy voice with trailing sentence endings.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: たしかに、メイちゃんいつも可愛い格好してるよね。どこで服買ってるの？
lines.en: True, you always dress so cute. Where do you buy your clothes?
lines.style: Friendly compliment with curious upward inflection.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: えへへ、同じ店ばっかり繰り返すタイプかも。落ち着くお店があってね。
lines.en: Hehe, I'm the type who keeps going back to the same shop. There's one that feels cozy.
lines.style: Bashful giggle followed by gentle confession.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: いいね！今度いっしょに行こうよ。私、休みの日はだいたい家にこもっちゃうから。
lines.en: Nice! Let's go together sometime. I usually shut myself in at home on days off.
lines.style: Bright invitation, energy lifting in second half.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: ぜひぜひ。日曜なら空いてるよ。アオイちゃんとお買い物、楽しみすぎる〜。
lines.en: Yes please. Sunday works for me. Shopping with you sounds way too fun.
lines.style: Excited but soft, drawn-out final vowel.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: じゃあ決まり！朝ごはんも食べて、一日まるごと遊んじゃおうね。
lines.en: Then it's settled! Let's eat breakfast too and play the whole day.
lines.style: Decisive cheerful close, planning a fun day.
